deterministicScope: The registered DOOM IWAD (DOOM.WAD, 27 maps / 3 episodes) is proprietary and never bundled — the C1 product target is shareware (PRIMARY_TARGET.gameMode shareware, DOOM1.WAD). The registered parity smoke is intrinsically conditional: it runs `bun run doom.ts -iwad iwad/DOOM.WAD` ONLY when the user supplies iwad/DOOM.WAD, and is correctly skipped (not failed) when absent. This gate proves that conditional behaviour deterministically: scope contract, correct presence detection, the shareware copy is not misclassified as registered, and the registered smoke is presence-gated.
